title: 第十一章 斗志斗勇第十二章 孤注峰
content_zh:
在魔族一干人等退去后，武书也是与影媚儿拉开了一定距离，影媚儿身上的束缚也是随之消失。
没有了束缚，影媚儿冷冷道，“人族，你很好？我影媚儿记住你了。”
冲着影媚儿耸了耸肩，武书无所谓的道，“你若不是一个聪明人，我不相信你在刚刚会一句话都不说。”
被武书这么一说，影媚儿见怪不怪。先前武书所展露出的那一手，至少说明一点，在符文阵法一道上面武书的实力肯定是不俗的。否则，也不可能这么轻易就将她控制住。
能对符文这般巧妙的运用以及对符文之力的精妙掌控，这可不是普通符文强者能够做到的。而修炼阵法一道，最考验一个人的心气及精神力。会败在武书手中，影媚儿虽觉得是自己大意了，却也是对武书非常忌惮的，武书这种人正是影魔族的克星。
哼了一声，影媚儿试探道，“小子，你的实力的确是让我感到意外，你叫什么名字？”
听到影媚儿这种高高在上的语气与自己说话，武书是很不喜欢的，武书是立马抬手示意道，“小魔女，若是想要与我说话，最好先搞清楚你现在的处境。在我面前，你只是手下败将。魔族之中，不是有句话吗？在胜者面前，废物只是废物。”
影媚儿直接被气得牙根痒痒道，“你……我……”
武书毫不留情面道，“你什么你？我什么我？别以为，你们魔族的事情很神秘。在我面前，你们魔族的所谓秘密都是不值一提的小事情。记得没错的话，魔族中不还有一句话吗？所谓信仰，不分种族不分贵贱，在魔神的信仰面前，人人平等。而身为魔族的人，特别是高贵的魔族，不仅会对信仰心生敬畏，还会对自己的所言所行负责。”
“若是违背信仰或者誓言，就宛如违背了大魔神的神光。”
这最后，武书还不忘强调一句，“小魔女，信仰不分种族，誓言超越永恒，这些话你不会不懂吧？”
虽然说，武书现在所言，站在一旁的李剑锋听得并不是很明白。而影媚儿的脸色却是因为武书的所言，变化不定，从一点微红到满头大汗的涨红，再到后来身体出现了颤抖。
影媚儿非常清楚，武书的目的是什么。武书说了这么多关于魔族魔神的事情，无非是在告诉影媚儿，在与武书交手时，影媚儿说过‘今日若是不废了你，我影媚儿就不是影魔族子民。’
如此誓言，影媚儿今日肯定是难以实现的，至少以武书在阵法符文上所表现出来的实力，正面刚，影媚儿不是对手。
而在看到影媚儿的神情变化后，武书在心里很满意的自语道，“厚土大陆上魔族所遵守的规则，似乎和遗忘大陆上的魔族规则相差不大。不错，不错。败者服输，答应胜者所提要求。”
打是打不过武书的，而武书的一番话，算是让影媚儿听出了内伤。刚刚听到武书说起魔神信仰时，影媚儿本打算说，尔等并非魔族，魔族的信仰与誓言在尔等面前无效。可武书那句，信仰不分种族，誓言超越永恒，直接是将影媚儿的话堵在胸口了。
未曾想到，一时大意，竟是被人族摆了一道，影媚儿很是直截了当的道，“竟然你对我们魔族的事情这么了解，那么我很想知道，接下来你想让我怎么做。”
被影媚儿这么一问，武书也是头大起来。魔族子民一旦违背誓言，往往想要解开誓言，不是用自我生命的鲜血捍卫誓言，那便是要选择向胜者服输。服输与臣服虽说是两码事，却也有根本上的不同。
魔族誓言战败者，需要答应胜者一个甚至多个要求。
当然，巨象山脉毕竟是在堃国境内，武书又是堃国子民，即便知道魔族世界的规则，武书也不想向影媚儿提出什么过分要求。

而见武书一副思考的样子，影媚儿冷冷的强调道，“小子，记住我的名字，我叫影媚儿。若是你敢想借着魔族规则向我提出什么过分要求，小心，改日我的家族会举全族之力将堃国灭掉。”
也是与影媚儿对视上，武书摇头笑道，“放心，我对魔族的同修之道不感兴趣。至于主仆关系？你太弱小，我也不感兴趣。嗯……烦心了，一时间不知道该怎么决定了。”
不会要求那种事情？也不会要求主仆关系？
事情没这么发展下去，影媚儿反倒是心中极度不爽了。怎么的，是本魔女的脸蛋身材不行，还是本魔女配不上你。话说，你们男人好色，是只看女人的战斗力行不行的吗？若是这种男人，你确定你是在找女人，而不是在找打手。
一瞬间，影媚儿脑袋中想过了这么多事情。
有了这些心思后，再看向武书，武书这张脸看着还真不错，一觉察到心动的感觉，影媚儿心里不由自语道，“我这是怎么了？怎么会对人族小子心生情愫，难道只因为对方长得帅吗？”
而一时半会武书也是想不到什么事情，是值得让影媚儿去做的。武书冲着影媚儿道，“这样吧？你先留在我身边，若是在走出大阵时，我还想不到想要做的事情，那么此次就先欠着，他日若是有缘相遇，那么此次的事情便日后再论。如何？”
content_en:
After the demon clan retreated, Wu Shu also distanced himself from Ying Meier, and the restraints on Ying Meier disappeared.
Without the restraints, Ying Mei'er said coldly, "Human race, are you okay? I, Ying Mei'er, will remember you."
Shrugging at Ying Mei'er, Wu Shu said nonchalantly, "If you weren't a smart person, I don't believe you wouldn't have said a word just now."
When Wu Shu said this, Ying Meier was not surprised. The skill shown by Wu Shu before at least shows that Wu Shu's strength in the rune formation is definitely good. Otherwise, it would be impossible to control her so easily.
Being able to use runes so skillfully and control the power of runes so well is not something ordinary rune masters can do. And practicing the formation together is the most test of a person's heart and mental strength. Although Ying Mei'er felt that she was being careless, she would be defeated by Wu Shu, but she was also very afraid of Wu Shu. People like Wu Shu were the nemesis of the Shadow Demon Clan.
With a snort, Ying Meier tentatively asked, "Boy, your strength really surprises me. What's your name?"
Wu Shu didn't like it when he heard Ying Meier talking to him in such a condescending tone. Wu Shu immediately raised his hand and said, "Little witch, if you want to talk to me, you'd better understand your current situation first. In front of me, you are just a defeated general. Isn't there a saying among the demons? In front of the winner, trash is just trash."
Ying Meier was so angry that her teeth itched and said, "You...I..."
Wu Shu said mercilessly, "What do you mean by you? What do I mean by me? Don't think that things about your demon clan are mysterious. In front of me, the so-called secrets of your demon clan are trivial matters that are not worth mentioning. If you remember correctly, isn't there a saying in the demon clan? The so-called faith, regardless of race or high status, in the face of the faith of the demon god, everyone is equal. And as a demon clan, especially a noble demon clan, not only will they be in awe of their faith, but they will also be responsible for what they say and do."
"If you violate your faith or oath, it is like violating the divine light of the Great Demon God."
At the end, Wu Shu did not forget to emphasize, "Little witch, your faith does not distinguish between races, and you swear to transcend eternity. You don't understand these words, do you?"
Although Li Jianfeng, who was standing aside, didn't quite understand what Wu Shu was saying now. However, Ying Meier's face changed erratically because of what Wu Shu said, from a little red to red with sweat, and then her body started to tremble.
Ying Meier knew very well what the purpose of Wu Shu was. Wu Shu said so many things about the Demon Clan and the Demon God, and he was just telling Ying Mei'er that when fighting Wu Shu, Ying Mei'er said, 'If I don't destroy you today, I, Ying Mei'er, will not be a citizen of the Shadow Demon Clan. ’
Such an oath would definitely be difficult for Ying Meier to fulfill today. At least with the strength shown in the formation runes in Wushu, Ying Meier was no match for her head-on.
After seeing the change in Ying Meier's expression, Wu Shu said to himself with satisfaction, "The rules followed by the demons on the Thick Earth Continent seem to be not much different from the rules of the demons on the Forgotten Continent. Not bad, not bad. The loser admits defeat and agrees to the winner's request."
Wushu couldn't be beaten with a beating, but Wushu's words made Ying Meier feel internal injuries. When she just heard Wu Shu talk about the belief in demon gods, Ying Meier originally planned to say that you are not demons, and the beliefs and oaths of demons are invalid in front of you. But the words in the martial arts book, that faith does not distinguish between races, and vows to transcend eternity, directly blocked Ying Meier's words in her chest.
She never thought that due to her carelessness, she would be tricked by the human race. Ying Meier said very straightforwardly, "You know so much about our demon race, so I really want to know what you want me to do next."
When Ying Mei'er asked this question, Wu Shu's head started to grow. Once the demon people break their oath,Often, if you want to break your oath, you have to either defend it with the blood of your own life, or you have to choose to surrender to the winner. Although surrender and surrender are two different things, they are also fundamentally different.
The demon swears that the loser must agree to one or more demands of the winner.
Of course, the Giant Elephant Mountain Range is within the territory of Kun Country after all, and Wu Shu is a citizen of Kun Country. Even if he knows the rules of the demon world, Wu Shu does not want to make any excessive demands to Ying Meier.
Seeing Wu Shu's thoughtful look, Ying Mei'er emphasized coldly, "Boy, remember my name. My name is Ying Mei'er. If you dare to make any excessive demands to me through the rules of the demon clan, be careful. One day my family will use all its strength to destroy the Kun Kingdom."
Looking into Ying Mei'er's eyes, Wu Shu shook his head and smiled, "Don't worry, I'm not interested in the way of fellow demon cultivators. As for the master-servant relationship? You're too weak, and I'm not interested either. Hmm... I'm annoyed. I don't know how to decide for a while."
Wouldn't you ask for that kind of thing? Nor does it require a master-servant relationship?
When things didn't develop like this, Ying Meier felt extremely unhappy. What's the matter? It's because my face and figure are not good enough, or because I'm not good enough for you. By the way, you men are so lustful, do you only depend on a woman’s fighting ability? If you are this kind of man, you must be sure that you are looking for a woman, not a thug.
In an instant, Ying Meier thought about so many things in her head.
After having these thoughts in mind, she looked at Wu Shu. Wu Shu's face looked really nice. As soon as she noticed her heartbeat, Ying Meier couldn't help but said to herself, "What's wrong with me? Why do I have feelings for a human boy? Is it just because he is handsome?"
And even though he knew martial arts for a while, he couldn't think of anything worth asking Ying Meier to do. Wu Shu said to Ying Mei'er, "Is that so? You stay with me first. If I can't think of what I want to do when I walk out of the formation, then I'll owe it to you this time. If we meet by fate one day, then we can discuss this matter later. How about that?"
